note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), read offline from backend/library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz — the founder decision of 2026-11-18 that every Amharic work quotes OWB. Every quotation this sermon makes is OWB verbatim (the shortest contiguous OWB span carrying the clause), spliced by script; the 1962 UBS wording it used to carry is gone.

A `mined` row means its quotation is an exact substring of the OWB verse, measured against the finished text. `self_rendered` rows are either the author's own allusions in prose (Scripture he paraphrases without quoting, left as prose), or quotations OWB cannot carry: Galatians 2:20's "by the faith of the Son of God" (Simpson argues from the KJV's genitive against "faith on the Son"; OWB reads በማመን, the very sense he rejects) and 1 Corinthians 1:30 spoken by Christ in the first person ("I am made unto you Wisdom").

Prose adjusted for OWB: the two rhetorical questions Simpson builds on Matthew 22:42 ("What think you of Bethshan / of divine healing?") now echo OWB's ያላችሁ አመለካከት ምንድን ነው? wording, and the Colossians 1:26 "hidden from ages and from generations" clause in his voice now uses OWB's ባለፉት ዘመናትና ትውልዶች ሁሉ ተሰውሮ የነበረው.
